annotator: Actual human operator, watching the original source in full; generated prompts and pose predictions hidden

side.definition: Actual anatomical side visible in the source; never infer from image side or requested prompt
side.bilateral: Valid observed fact; not eligible for the first single-side temporal model.

boundary_rule: Select an actual decoded frame PTS; do not reconstruct or round to a nominal frame-rate grid

phases.meaning: Visible starting posture before the arm begins moving away from the body
Visible upper-arm movement away from the starting posture
Observed upper-arm turning point or maintained endpoint; no prescribed healthy range assumed
Visible movement back toward the starting posture
Rest, returned starting posture or another visible activity; unknown spans remain masked

phase_interval.end_inclusion: half-open training interval; original endpoint PTS retained
phase_interval.unobserved_spans: no supervision; never fill from prompts or model outputs

repetition.completed: An observable full raising and lowering process that returns to its visible starting posture; all five ordered boundaries independently confirmed
repetition.partial: An observable incomplete process; amplitude alone is not completeness
repetition.unobservable: Unknown completion and false mask; no invented zero or negative

observable_count.known_zero: Only after full-video viewing confirms no complete target repetition
observable_count.known_positive: Must equal the number of explicitly completed observable repetitions in the full inventory

items.meaning: Visible elbow bending during the reviewed interval on the observed test side; this is an image event, not a diagnosis, contraindication or clinical error.
Clearly visible lateral torso leaning relative to the observed starting posture; not a spinal segment measurement or a clinical ROM conclusion.

observable_changes.mask_independence: Assessed-but-unjudgeable: assessable=false with assessability_mask=true, while state=unknown and label_mask=false. Assessable=true does not by itself set a state label.
observable_changes.known_state_requires: assessable=true, assessability_mask=true, state present/absent and label_mask=true; actual original media PTS start_s/end_s required.
observable_changes.absence_scope: Absent only in the explicitly reviewed and assessable interval. Never infer absence from missing joints, unknown state, requested scenario or absence of clinical review.
observable_changes.unknown_times: Unknown state keeps start_s/end_s null. This schema does not represent timed intervals of unassessability; retain that limitation rather than inventing times.
observable_changes.legacy_empty_quality: Valid and entirely unknown for both observations.

clinical_quality.requires: Two independent qualified human reviewers and a third adjudicator, with source SHA and review evidence

evaluation_event_semantics.human: Physically visible phase boundary in source media
evaluation_event_semantics.B0: Unchanged ProtocolEngine confirmation event, including original observation and hysteresis delays
evaluation_event_semantics.B2: Causal model phase transition decoded from arrived source frames
evaluation_event_semantics.limitation: Boundary timing differences include estimator confirmation delay; they are not clinical ROM or diagnostic accuracy

migration: Repository specification only. Preserve the external immutable v1 copy; publish v2 under a distinct versioned path. Legacy quality=[] remains unknown, never absent.

factual_coverage_reporting.requested_scenarios: A-F are generation targets only, not observed category labels.
factual_coverage_reporting.overlap: Report observed facts as independent overlapping properties. A clip may contain a complete roundtrip, a hold, slower motion and visible elbow bending at the same time.
factual_coverage_reporting.complete_and_partial: Use independently masked human observable_completion and full repetition inventory; amplitude alone does not determine completeness.
factual_coverage_reporting.speed: Report actual PTS durations with known-boundary counts. Do not assign a slow category without a predeclared operational definition.
factual_coverage_reporting.hold: Report explicitly reviewed endpoint/hold intervals and durations; do not copy requested seconds.
factual_coverage_reporting.other_activity: No complete repetition is not proof of unrelated activity; require explicit human activity/phase evidence and report unknown coverage.
factual_coverage_reporting.observable_changes: For each problem separately report cohort N, human-reviewed source N, assessability true/false/unknown N, present/absent/unknown N, known interval coverage and missing masks. Do not merge unassessable into absent.
factual_coverage_reporting.six_class_completion: Target slot counts, source acceptance counts and actual factual coverage are separate results. Current observation fields do not by themselves prove a mutually exclusive six-class dataset or clinical quality.
